adjudication.rationale: The finding correctly identifies a race condition in the pagination code. Looking at the diff, the `next` and `previous` actions (lines 30-47) synchronously set `offset` on the group model and then call `group.findMembers()` which is an async AJAX call. The `findMembers` method (in group.js) makes an AJAX request and in its `.then()` callback sets properties including `offset`, `members`, etc. If a user clicks rapidly (double-click or slow network), multiple requests can be in-flight simultaneously, and responses arriving out-of-order will overwrite the current state with stale data. There's no request cancellation, debouncing, or sequence tracking to prevent this. This is a real race condition bug.
